title: 第10章 生活在好时代
content_zh:
第10章生活在好时代
“在四十多年前，也就是2036年，人类第一次登上荧火星。”安格斯说道，“并且在荧火星上有了惊人发现，之前这些都是保密的，今日可向全球民众公开部分。”
安格斯秘书长站了起来，他身后巨大光幕显现出荧火星的场景——一座破败的巨大的钢铁城市。
“这是荧火星上一座地底城市废墟，残留遗迹可以推断，它长三十六公里，宽二十五公里，就仿佛一座巨型地下堡垒。”安格斯秘书长说道，接着他又一挥手，屏幕中又换了一个场景——一尊人类雕塑。
“这座雕塑，是创作于三千万年前，和我们人类酷似的雕塑。”安格斯秘书长说道，“同样发现在荧火星上。”
安格斯秘书长根本没做太多解释，又一挥手，又出现了更震撼的场景——在一座大峡谷深处有一艘庞大的崭新宇宙飞船，断裂成了两截。
“这艘宇宙飞船，长五点八公里。坠落断裂的时间，应该是一百万年前。”安格斯秘书长说道，“我们发现时，这艘断裂的宇宙飞船是被峡谷给掩埋了，将它从废墟中挖掘出来后，简单维护，却发现这艘飞船依旧崭新，并未腐朽。这艘飞船所蕴含的科技，简直匪夷所思。”
安格斯秘书长说完后，暂时停了了下来。
可全球此刻却沸腾了。
“这是什么？”
“这么庞大的钢铁城市？”
“这是宇宙飞船吗？长五点八公里？”
“百万年岁月，材料依旧崭新？这是什么科技技术？”
“这艘宇宙飞船内，到底有什么科技？”
“那座雕塑，三千万年前的雕塑，依旧保持整体模样，这雕塑材料牛逼啊。而且还是人类模样？”
“荧火星上，过去有人类？”
全球各地的人们，都在惊叹议论着。
安格斯秘书长沉默片刻，翻看着手中的稿件，随即抬头接着道：“荧火星，是我们整个人类的财富，所以在2056年我们组建了蓝星联盟，共同开发荧火星。”
2036年登上荧火星。
2056年，全球组建蓝星联盟。

“全球合力开发荧火星，从荧火星上获得的科技，也将造福整个人类。”安格斯微笑道，“比如虚拟眼镜技术，就是源自于荧火星上的虚拟头盔。”
安格斯从一旁箱子内，取出了一个银灰色头盔。
“虚拟眼镜技术，虚拟程度只能算达到30%，但虚拟头盔技术……”安格斯说道，“我们蓝星在付出无比巨大代价后，如今终于将其攻克。”
“戴上虚拟头盔，大脑神经将和虚拟头盔接驳，大脑意识则是进入虚拟世界。”安格斯说道，“第一，虚拟程度可以达到近乎100%，触觉嗅觉都能模拟，人的身体都能百分百虚拟。”
所有观看直播的人们都惊呆了。
近乎100%虚拟？
“第二，因为进入虚拟世界后，身体完全处于休息状态，大脑则仿佛是做梦。所以人们可以利用‘睡觉’的时间进入虚拟世界。使得我们一天的可利用时间，大大提升。我们除了白天可以学习工作，夜里在虚拟世界，同样可以学习、科学研究，也可以娱乐。”安格斯秘书长微笑道，“科技改变人类，以后我们的睡眠时间，也可彻底利用起来。”
“这就是科技改变人类？”
“睡觉时间，进入虚拟世界？”许景明、黎渺渺他们一家人都震撼了。
“我年轻的时候，还是手游时代呢。这才六七十年……都有虚拟世界了？我八十八岁了，还能看到这一天？”许老爷子都惊呆了。
“虚拟头盔，并不是我们开发荧火星最大的收获。”安格斯说道，“今天的发布会，虚拟头盔只是排在第二项，排在第一的是……人类进化！”
“进化？”
全球人们都仔细听着，虚拟头盔还只是排第二？人类进化排第一？
“我们从荧火星上，挖掘出了一些远古科技，其中就有基因进化法。”安格斯说道，“经过多年的试验，在这里，我们全球人们需要向那些因为试验而付出生命的志愿者们，表示感谢。他们是整个人类的英雄。”
身后屏幕中浮现了一个个人的影像，男男女女。
全球人们都沉默了。
为了试验，许多志愿者死去了吗？
“经过多年试验，我们已经摸索出了百分百成功的基因进化法。”安格斯说道，“符合我们蓝星上所有人类的方法。”
“基因进化，听起来很不可思议，但原理却非常简单。”
“就像一个拳击手，长期练拳，他的拳头筋骨都将远超普通人。他的孩子，受遗传基因影响，也会拳头筋骨天生就更强。这就是基因的小幅度进化！”

“人们早就发现，锻炼，可以身体强壮。锻炼，可以减少许多疾病。锻炼，可以长寿。”
“但那都是我们从日常习惯，总结出的简单锻炼方法。”
安格斯秘书长说道，“如果科技能够发达到监察人类的基因，根据人类锻炼，引起的基因变化进行总结……监察百万人类，乃至上亿人类基因的变化。最终总结出的锻炼进化方案，将会不可思议。”
“这是荧火星上发现的基因进化法，经过我们试验后，确定适合蓝星人类的十种进化法。”
身后的屏幕中出现了十本书册，每本都有外星文字。
“请看半年前邀请的一批实验者。”安格斯秘书长指向光幕。
身后的巨大光幕中，出现了上千人们，男男女女，有老有少，有残疾的，有病恹恹的，也有健壮的，有老得快死的……
他们全都戴着银灰色头盔，躺在一个个床上。
“他们超过一半都有绝症，也有五分之一是残疾人。”安格斯秘书长说道，“进化法的学习并不容易，每次会让身体疲惫不堪，动作若是错误，更是有害。所以这些志愿者们都是在虚拟头盔中学习，确定在虚拟世界完全学会了，那么现实中也就会了。”
“仅仅三个月，这批实验者们便发生了蜕变。”
安格斯秘书长振奋说道。
只见一个个残疾人，有的断腿，有的断手，但在视频中，断肢处竟然逐渐生长，最终个个完全长好。
许多白发苍苍的老人，随着时间，头发渐渐变得乌黑，皱纹消失，变得年轻。
病恹恹的绝症病人，逐渐健康，甚至气色红润。
“他们的基因发生了进化，彻底蜕变到了一个新的层次。”安格斯秘书长说道。
“这是一场百米跑测试，之前全球百米世界纪录，是秒。而这八位实验者……”安格斯秘书长看着屏幕。
伴随着一声枪响，八名实验者个个飞窜而出，犹如猎豹般，快的身影都模糊，很快冲到了终点。
最快的一名实验者，成绩是：秒。
“他们八人，仅仅学习了基因进化法三个月，百米跑普遍在五秒多。”安格斯秘书长说道。
屏幕上，又有年轻人抓着杠铃，杠铃杆比奥赛杠铃杆还粗，可两侧厚重的哑铃片依旧让粗大的杠杆都弯了。

可这年轻人一发力，便已然举过头顶。
“没有经过专业举重练习，一个普通年轻人，一千公斤重的杠铃，双手轻易举起。”
屏幕上，有人一跃，跃过了高高的横杆。
“一跃，三米九高度。”
安格斯秘书长说道，“跳得更高、跑得更快、举起来的更重，身体恢复力变得强大，断肢可以再生，过去的绝症对进化后的人类，就像是一个小感冒，身体免疫力自然就消灭掉它。人类已知所有绝症，进化后的身体都能消灭，最重要的是……寿命也变了，经过我们确定，进化后的人类，寿命普遍将在160岁到200岁。人类寿命提升了整整一倍。”
此话一出，全球许多人们都沸腾了。
“所有绝症都能消灭？断肢重生？”津门市，客厅内，抱着儿子看着直播的杨青烁愣愣看着这一切。
“妈的病可以治了？我的手，也能再长出来了？”杨青烁喃喃低语。
滴滴滴，旁边有小屏幕浮现。
“小烁，小烁，听到了吗？断肢可以再长出来，视频里面，两条腿都断了，都长出来了。你只是一只手，一定能再长出来的。”杨母激动得满是泪水，儿子能够不再残疾，她便是死也满足了。
“妈，你的病也能好了。”杨青烁也是喜极而泣。
“是，我的病也能好了。”杨母连点头，“我们一家人又能在一起了，感谢这个时代，感谢这个时代啊。”
杨青烁低头看着儿子，儿子正在打着瞌睡，在等直播过程中他早睡着了，杨青烁激动得亲了儿子一口。
儿子睁开眼，睡眼惺忪看了眼老爸，迷迷糊糊地，又闭上眼接着睡了。
“陶陶睡着了？”杨母问道。
“所有娱乐全部暂停，动画片也没有，陶陶等困了。”杨青烁笑道。
杨母点头：“让他好好休息，我们家从今往后，要好起来了。”
“要好起来了。”杨青烁笑着，只觉得未来生活都充满了希望。
许景明一家人同样在激动中。
“所有绝症都能好？”

“断肢再长出来？”
“寿命160岁到200岁？”
这些消息让全家人都晕乎乎的。
许景明看向了身侧已经衰老的父母，父亲已经六十，母亲也有了些许白发，爷爷更是八十八了。自己生命中最重要的这些亲人们，都能活到160岁以上了？
“儿子，你的腿伤肯定能好。”母亲激动搂住许景明，“人家断腿都长出来，你那一点伤根本不值一提。”
许景明点头：“不过今后的武道大赛，肯定和过去不一样了，以后一个普通人都能双手举起上千公斤。”
“这是一个新时代。”许老爷子慨叹道，“在我小时候，家里用的还是电脑，我父亲他们玩的也是电脑游戏。我少年时，进入手机时代……我中老年时，便是虚拟眼镜时代……如今人类寿命都能翻倍了，我活到了一个好的时代啊。”
“是啊，活在了一个好的时代。”一旁的黎辰安和妻子也彼此相视。
“爸，妈，我们可以一直在一起，活到一百六十多岁。”黎渺渺也开心拥抱着父母。
“我们一家在一起。”黎辰安和妻子笑着，眼含泪花。

Chapter 10 Living in good times
"More than forty years ago, in 2036, humans first landed on the planet Mars." Angus said, "And they made amazing discoveries on the planet Mars. These were previously kept secret, but today some of them can be made public to the world."
Secretary-General Angus stood up, and the huge light screen behind him showed a scene of Yingming Mars - a huge, dilapidated steel city.
"This is the ruins of an underground city on Ying Mars. It can be inferred from the remaining ruins that it is thirty-six kilometers long and twenty-five kilometers wide. It is like a giant underground fortress." Secretary-General Angus said, and then he waved his hand again, and another scene changed on the screen - a human sculpture.
"This sculpture was created 30 million years ago and is very similar to us humans." Secretary-General Angus said, "It was also found on Mars."
Secretary-General Angus didn't explain much at all. He waved his hand again, and an even more shocking scene appeared - deep in a grand canyon, there was a huge new spaceship, broken into two pieces.
"This spacecraft is 5.8 kilometers long. The time when it fell and broke should be a million years ago." Secretary-General Angus said, "When we discovered this broken spacecraft, it was buried in a canyon. After digging it out from the ruins and doing simple maintenance, we found that this spacecraft is still brand new and has not decayed. The technology contained in this spacecraft is simply incredible."
After Secretary-General Angus finished speaking, he paused temporarily.
But the whole world is boiling at the moment.
"What is this?"
"Such a huge steel city?"
"Is this a spaceship? It's five point eight kilometers long?"
"After millions of years, the materials are still new? What kind of technology is this?"
"What kind of technology is inside this spaceship?"
"That sculpture, a sculpture from 30 million years ago, still maintains its overall appearance. The material of this sculpture is awesome. And it still looks like a human?"
"On Mars, were there humans in the past?"
People all over the world are talking in amazement.
Secretary-General Angus was silent for a moment, looking at the manuscript in his hand, then raised his head and continued: "Ying Mars is the wealth of our entire human race, so in 2056 we formed the Blue Star Alliance to jointly develop Ying Mars."
Landing on Mars in 2036.
In 2056, the Blue Star Alliance was formed globally.
"The world is working together to develop Glowing Mars, and the technology obtained from Glowing Mars will also benefit the entire human race." Angus smiled, "For example, the virtual glasses technology is derived from the virtual helmet on Glowing Mars."
Angus took out a silver-gray helmet from a box on the side.
"Virtual glasses technology can only be considered to be 30% virtual, but virtual helmet technology..." Angus said, "Our Blue Star has finally conquered it after paying an extremely huge price."
"Wearing a virtual helmet, the brain nerves will be connected to the virtual helmet, and the brain consciousness will enter the virtual world." Angus said, "First, the degree of virtuality can reach nearly 100%, touch and smell can be simulated, and the human body can be 100% virtual."
Everyone watching the live broadcast was shocked.
Almost 100% virtual?
"Second, because after entering the virtual world, the body is completely at rest, and the brain seems to be dreaming. Therefore, people can use the 'sleep' time to enter the virtual world. This greatly increases our available time in a day. In addition to studying and working during the day, we can also study, do scientific research, and have entertainment in the virtual world at night." Secretary-General Angus smiled, "Technology has changed human beings, and our sleep time can also be fully utilized in the future."
"Is this how technology changes humans?"
"Enter the virtual world during bedtime?" Xu Jingming, Li Miaomiao and their family were all shocked.
"My yearWhen I was young, it was still the era of mobile games. It's only been sixty or seventy years... but there is already a virtual world? I am eighty-eight years old, can I still see this day? "Mr. Xu was shocked.
“The virtual helmet is not the biggest gain from our development of Glowing Mars. "Angus said, "In today's press conference, the virtual helmet is only the second item, the first item is...human evolution! "
"Evolution? "
People around the world are listening carefully, virtual helmets are still only the second best? Human evolution ranks first?
"We have unearthed some ancient technologies from the planet Mars, including genetic evolution. Angus said, "After many years of trials, we all around the world need to express our gratitude to the volunteers who sacrificed their lives because of the trials. They are the heroes of all mankind. "
An image of a person, a man or a woman, appeared on the screen behind him.
People around the world were silent.
Did many volunteers die for the experiment?
"After years of experiments, we have figured out a genetic evolution method that is 100% successful. Angus said, "It is in line with the methods of all humans on our blue star." "
“Gene evolution sounds incredible, but the principle is very simple. "
“Just like a boxer, if he practices boxing for a long time, his fist muscles and bones will be far superior to ordinary people. His children will also be born with stronger fist muscles due to genetic influence. This is a small evolution of genes! "
“People have long discovered that exercise can make the body stronger. Exercise can reduce many diseases. Exercise can help you live longer. "
“But those are simple exercise methods we summarized from our daily habits. "
Secretary-General Angus said, "If technology can be developed to monitor human genes, and summarize the genetic changes caused by human exercise...monitor the genetic changes of millions of humans, or even hundreds of millions of humans. The resulting exercise evolution plan will be incredible. "
"This is the genetic evolution method discovered on Glowing Mars. After our experiments, we determined ten evolutionary methods that are suitable for humans on Blue Star. "
Ten books appeared on the screen behind him, each with alien text.
"Please look at the group of experimenters invited half a year ago. "Secretary-General Angus pointed to the light curtain.
In the huge light curtain behind him, thousands of people appeared, men and women, old and young, disabled, sick, strong, and almost dying of old...
They all wore silver-gray helmets and were lying on beds.
“More than half of them have terminal illnesses, and one-fifth are disabled. "Secretary-General Angus said, "Learning the evolutionary method is not easy. It will make the body exhausted every time. If the movements are wrong, it will be even more harmful. Therefore, these volunteers are learning in virtual helmets. If they have completely learned it in the virtual world, they will be able to do it in reality. "
“In just three months, these experimenters have undergone transformation. "
Secretary-General Angus said excitedly.
I saw disabled people all over the place, some with broken legs and some with broken hands. However, in the video, the broken limbs gradually grew, and eventually all of them fully grew back.
Many white-haired old people, as time goes by, their hair gradually turns black, their wrinkles disappear, and they become younger.
The terminally ill patient gradually became healthy and even looked rosy.
“Their genes have evolved and completely transformed to a new level. "Secretary-General Angus said.
“This is a 100-meter running test. The previous global 100-meter world record was set in seconds. And these eight experimenters..." Secretary-General Angus looked at the screen.
With the sound of a gunshot, the eight experimenters all flew out, like cheetahs, their silhouettes were blurred at such speed, and they quickly rushed to the finish line.
The fastest experimenter's result is: seconds.
"The eight of them have only learned the genetic evolution method for three months, and they can run a 100-meter run in more than five seconds. "Secretary-General Angus said.
on the screen againThere is a young man holding a barbell. The barbell is thicker than the Orsay barbell, but the thick dumbbell plates on both sides still bend the thick lever.
But as soon as the young man exerted his strength, he raised it above his head.
"Without professional weightlifting training, an ordinary young man can easily lift a thousand kilogram barbell with both hands."
On the screen, someone jumped over the high horizontal bar.
"One leap, a height of 3.9 meters."
Secretary-General Angus said, "Jump higher, run faster, lift heavier, the body's resilience becomes stronger, and broken limbs can be regenerated. The terminal diseases of the past are like a small cold to evolved humans, and the body's immunity will naturally eliminate them. All terminal diseases known to humans can be eliminated by the evolved body. The most important thing is... the life span has also changed. We have determined that the life span of evolved humans will generally be between 160 and 200 years old. Human life span has doubled."
As soon as these words came out, many people around the world were excited.
"Can all terminal diseases be eradicated? Amputated limbs can be reborn?" In the living room of Jinmen City, Yang Qingshuo, who was holding her son and watching the live broadcast, stared blankly at all this.
"Can Mom's disease be cured? Can my hands grow back?" Yang Qingshuo murmured.
Beep beep beep, a small screen appeared next to it.
"Xiao Shuo, Xiao Shuo, did you hear that? Broken limbs can grow back. In the video, both legs were broken and both grew back. You are just one hand, it will definitely grow back." Mother Yang was so excited that she burst into tears. She would be satisfied even if her son could no longer be disabled.
"Mom, your illness can be cured." Yang Qingshuo also cried with joy.
"Yes, my illness can also be cured." Mother Yang nodded, "Our family can be together again. Thank you for this era, thank you for this era."
Yang Qingshuo looked down at her son, who was dozing off. He had fallen asleep while waiting for the live broadcast. Yang Qingshuo was so excited that she kissed her son.
The son opened his eyes, looked at his father sleepily, then closed his eyes and fell asleep again.
"Is Tao Tao asleep?" Mother Yang asked.
"All entertainment has been suspended, and there are no cartoons. Tao Tao and others are sleepy." Yang Qingshuo said with a smile.
Mother Yang nodded: "Let him have a good rest. Our family will be better from now on."
"It's going to get better." Yang Qingshuo smiled, feeling that her future life was full of hope.
Xu Jingming's family was also excited.
“Can all terminal diseases be cured?”
"The severed limb will grow back?"
"Life span is 160 to 200 years?"
The whole family was stunned by the news.
Xu Jingming looked at his aging parents beside him. His father was sixty, his mother had some gray hair, and his grandfather was eighty-eight. Can the most important relatives in my life live to be over 160 years old?
"Son, your leg injury will definitely heal." The mother hugged Xu Jingming excitedly, "People's broken legs will grow back, and your injury is not worth mentioning at all."
Xu Jingming nodded: "But martial arts competitions in the future will definitely be different from the past. In the future, an ordinary person will be able to lift thousands of kilograms with both hands."
"This is a new era." Mr. Xu lamented, "When I was a child, computers were still used at home, and my father and others also played computer games. When I was a teenager, we entered the era of mobile phones... When I was middle-aged and old, it was the era of virtual glasses... Nowadays, human life span has doubled. I have lived in a good era."
"Yes, we live in a good era." Li Chenan and his wife looked at each other.
"Dad, Mom, we can always be together and live to be over 160 years old." Li Miaomiao also happily hugged her parents.
"Our family is together." Li Chenan and his wife smiled with tears in their eyes.
